name: Sinai
overview: Sinai is the mountain in the wilderness where the children of Israel camped during their journey from Egypt, marking a pivotal moment in their history as God called Moses from the mountain to deliver His law (Exodus 19:2-3). It is the place where God gave Moses the tablets of stone inscribed with His commandments, a divine revelation foundational to Israel's covenant relationship with Him (Exodus 24:12; 32:15-16). The wilderness of Sinai thus represents both a physical location and a spiritual setting where God's holy law was established and imparted to His people.
